operators.customDisplayName: Load 2024 CSN Report Categories data from CSV file at data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Report_Categories.csv with cp1252 encoding

operatorProperties.code:
def process(load_categories) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_categories.copy()
    # Use row 1 as header and skip everything before it
    df = df.iloc[1:].reset_index(drop=True)
    # Set column names from the first row (which is now row 0)
    df.columns = df.iloc[0]
    # Skip the header row and start from data
    df = df.iloc[1:].reset_index(drop=True)
    # Remove rows with NaN in Category column (footer/metadata)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Category'])
    # Remove duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Clean up column names (strip whitespace)
    df.columns = df.columns.str.strip()
    # Convert Number_of_Reports to numeric (removing commas)
    df['# of Reports'] = df['# of Reports'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    # Convert Percentage to numeric (removing %)
    df['Percentage'] = df['Percentage'].astype(str).str.replace('%', '').astype(float)
    # Keep only necessary columns
    df = df[['Category', '# of Reports', 'Percentage']]
    return df

operators.customDisplayName: Clean the categories data: use row 1 as header, skip metadata rows, remove duplicates, convert numeric columns (remove commas from report counts, % from percentages), keep only Category, # of Reports, and Percentage columns

operatorProperties.code:
def process(clean_categories) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = clean_categories.copy()
    
    # Sort by # of Reports in descending order
    df = df.sort_values('# of Reports', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Calculate cumulative reports and cumulative percentage
    total_reports = df['# of Reports'].sum()
    df['Cumulative Reports'] = df['# of Reports'].cumsum()
    df['Cumulative Percentage'] = (df['Cumulative Reports'] / total_reports) * 100
    
    # Find minimum number of categories to reach 50%
    categories_for_50pct = (df['Cumulative Percentage'] >= 50).idxmax() + 1
    
    return df[['Category', '# of Reports', 'Cumulative Reports', 'Cumulative Percentage']].head(categories_for_50pct + 2)

operators.customDisplayName: Sort categories by report count descending, calculate cumulative reports and percentage, identify minimum number of categories needed to reach 50% cumulative threshold
